text:
1. 16. 4. 11. 

Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ. Atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ. Evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃvijjanti. Atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu na saṃvijjanti.
